thesis: Broadcom's strong margins, free cash flow, analyst support, and positive trend justify a buy signal, but the valuation requires continued earnings execution.
strongest_counterexample: The 69.3x trailing P/E, 1.47 beta, and low volume could indicate that much of the expected growth is already priced in.
invalidation_conditions: Material deterioration in free cash flow or operating margin
Price falling below the 200-day moving average
Forward earnings estimates being revised materially lower
evidence_gaps: No detailed bridge from trailing to forward earnings
decisive_factors: 36.2% net margin and positive free cash flow
Price above all three major moving averages
source_note: Fresh Layer 1 data plus current-session English research-only analysis. Portfolio and Layer 5 are excluded.
